question: Voyager 1 travels at about 17 km/s. How long would it take to cover the 4.2 light-years to the nearest star, in thousands of years?
move: Put the distance in the traveller's units before calling it near.
trap: Assuming the fastest craft leaving the Solar System would get there in centuries.
hint: Turn light-years into km, and the speed into km per year.
steps: A light-year is about 9.5 trillion km, so 4.2 light-years is about 40 trillion km.
A year has about 31.6 million seconds, so 17 km/s is about 540 million km a year.
reference: Bell, The Interstellar Age: Inside the Forty-Year Voyager Mission, Dutton, 2015
